reviews.review_msg: Great prof, who's passionate about what he does and takes the time to really help students out. His office hours and break's during class always have a line of people bc he really takes the time to give good feedback

I've taken all of the classes Prof. Evan Freeman has to offer at SFU and would've kept taking more if it was possible. His classes are discussion heavy but he is accommodating for those who aren't the biggest talkers. His joy for his subject and teaching makes his classes incredibly enjoyable and he is easy to speak to if you encounter troubles.

one of the best profs ive ever had... he was extremely passionate and personable.. his lectures were very interesting and he definitely made a 3 hour class pass by quickly. He's one of those profs that have so much knowledge and excitement about what they're teaching, which makes it very easy to stay engaged and actually want to do a good job

Loved Evan!! He was extremely passionate, which made the subject all the more interesting. He posts assigned readings for the objects you learn about, but as long as you pay attention & take notes during lectures, you don't need to read anything. Slides are posted, have accompanying study questions, & the online quizzes are straightforward.
Very nice and lectures were always well done and engaging, you can tell he cared about the material a lot and was always excited to teach. Was easily one of my favourite courses. :)
